items.title: Sylvester Handy Interview, 1961-12-13
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Slowdrag; the mention is made solely by the interviewer in the context of a comparison.

ctx.x: A coincidence. When I was small, before I had a bass... I had one. No, thank you. No. And uh... My instrument was made out of a soap box.
Oh, Slowdrag made one of homemade ones too. Yeah.

Yeah. Yeah. And uh... We were um... Made it out of a soap box. And ironed into whether you believe it or not. Julius Handy, Sylvester Handy, and John Handy was playing mandolin. My oldest brother was playing mandolin. We was always musicians. He played mandolin, John Handy, Julius Handy on guitar, Sylvester Handy on bass. And my bass was made out of a soap box. So... It had a string, string tree out of it. Three strings, three strings. Yeah. You understand? Every second of it. And you wouldn't imagine during…
